'''Fiberplast''' was an incredibly strong fiber.<ref name="COMPLETE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref><ref name="GALAXIES">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided Quick Reference Guide]]''</ref>

==Characteristics==
Fiberplast was an incredibly strong material used to make doors and other building materials, though it also had a multitude of uses in the production of starship components,<ref name="COMPLETE" /> and was notably used in the construction of [[StealthX]] hulls. Fiberplast was also used in the construction of heavy clothing and armors.<ref name="GALAXIES" />
